## MidnightTakeableOffer interface

ABI-ready Midnight takeable offer returned by quote/takeable-offer APIs.

Pass these objects unchanged into `takeLend`<!-- -->, `takeBorrow`<!-- -->, or `supplyCollateralTakeBorrow`<!-- -->; the action builders validate side and market consistency before encoding the bundle.
